name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 2 – Am 41
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 2b. Considers that in light of the United States’ past and ongoing violations of international law and the negative impact of US military interventions on neighbouring regions, the foreign, security and defence policy of the Union and Member States can no longer be aligned with the framework of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO); calls, therefore, on the European Council to start the process of revising the EU Treaties to remove this requirement from the Treaty on European Union;
